name: monade-stack-config

schema.title: Monade CLI Stack Configuration
schema.description: The configuration file to get a local stack up and running with Monade CLI

name.description: The name of the stack. It will be used as a prefix for the stack's resources

nginx.description: Specifies whether to use the system-wide nginx service or spawn a local nginx process among other services. If not specified, 'system' is implied. Local nginx requires an nginx binary in the path. System wide nginx configuration is left to the user.

services.description: The services to be run in the stack. Each service is represented by its name, which is the key

bastion.description: The bastion configuration for the stack. Use this to quick connect to the bastion host of the stack with `monade bastion`

host.description: The bastion host to connect to. Can be an ip address or a domain

user.description: The user to connect to the bastion host

key_path.description: The path to the private key to use to connect to the bastion host. Please note that the key should be store in a directory outside the stack directory, to avoid being included in the stack repository

command.description: The command to be run to start the service. If the command has spaces it must be double quoted

cwd.description: The working directory for the command. This directory will be cd'd into before running the command

env.description: A list of environment variables to be set for the command. Each item in the list should be a string in the form of `KEY=VALUE`

env_file.description: If set all environment variables in the file will be set for the command. The file should be in the format of `KEY=VALUE` with each key-value pair on a new line

domains.description: A list of domains to be proxied to the service. Each item in the list must be a string. In our local stacks domains should use the `test` tld

port.description: This is the port the proxy will use to forward requests to the service. It must be unique for each service in the stack. Please note that the process should be configured to run on this port, and concurrent stacks could interfere one with another.The port must be set along with domains for the service to be proxied

proxy_https.description: If set to true, the proxy will forward requests to the service using HTTPS. The service must be configured to accept HTTPS requests. Setting this has no effect on the proxy external connections, that are always https

autostart.description: If set to true, the service will be started when the stack is started. If set to false, the service will not be started automatically when the stack is started.

stop_sequence.description: The key sequence to be used by the stack runner to stop the service. For docker services use 'C-c'. If not set a SIGTERM will be sent. The sequence must be a combination of keys, emacs-style, for example for ctrl+c use 'C-c'. Do not specify SIGTERM or SIGKILL

nginx_server_options.description: A list of options to be set for the server block in the nginx configuration for this process. Here should be nginx general configurations. This is a map, the key is the name of the directive, the value is the argument

nginx_location_options.description: A list of options to be set for the location block in the nginx configuration for this process. Here should be proxy-related configurations. This is a map, the key is the name of the directive, the value is the argument

description:
The development stack is called **dev‑stack** and it runs a dedicated local nginx instance. To reach the stack remotely you can tunnel through the bastion host **bastion.dev.example.com** using the user **ubuntu** and the private key located at `~/.config/monade/dev-stack/bastion_key.pem`.

The stack comprises three services:

* **web** – started with `npm start` inside the *frontend* directory. It receives the environment variables `NODE_ENV=development` and `PORT=3000`, listens on port 3000, and is exposed at the domain **frontend.test** (HTTP only). The service is set to autostart. Nginx is configured for this server with `client_max_body_size 50m` and `keepalive_timeout 65s`; the location block adds the headers `Host $http_host` and `X-Real-IP $remote_addr`.

* **api** – launched via `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000` from the *backend* directory, loading all variables from the `.env` file. It runs on port 8000, is reachable at **api.test**, and the proxy forwards requests over HTTPS. The service autostarts and will be stopped with the key sequence **C‑c**. Nginx adds the headers `X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for` and `X-NginX-Proxy true` for this location.

* **worker** – executed with `python worker.py` in the *worker* folder, using the environment variables `QUEUE=high` and `CONCURRENCY=4`. This background process does not start automatically and can be stopped with **C‑d**. No proxy or domain is configured for the worker.
